description: This file implements functions related to launching and managing text editors within a Git environment, including selecting the editor based on environment variables and configuration, launching editors, and editing files interactively.

methods.name: int is_terminal_dumb(void)
methods.description: Checks if the current terminal environment is 'dumb' by inspecting the TERM environment variable.

methods.name: const char * git_editor(void)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate editor to use, based on environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: const char * git_sequence_editor(void)
methods.description: Gets the editor for sequence operations, falling back to the regular editor if necessary.

methods.name: int launch_specified_editor(const char * editor,const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches a specified editor on a given file path, handles terminal hints, and reads the file after editing.

methods.name: int launch_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the default editor on a specified file path.

methods.name: int launch_sequence_editor(const char * path,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor on a specified file path.

methods.name: int strbuf_edit_interactively(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * buffer,const char * path,const char * const * env)
methods.description: Allows editing of a buffer interactively by writing it to a file, invoking an editor, and reading the modifications back.
